notes.title: Gigapocalypse Full Release Update: New Gigas, New Stages, Endings and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40105546/ec5f4f66047464e343ad6b51f6edacbf9372b86f.png[/img]

Greetings Kaijū lovers,

The time has finally come: The full release update for [b]Gigapocalypse[/b] has been published! You can expect 3 new Gigas (Gold King, Blight Queen and Ezer), 2 new stages and of course the update brings the campaigns to an end. With 9 Gigas in the game, that makes a total of 9 different endings - so there's a lot to do:

[previewyoutube=CdYeqOt70LA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Finally here is what to expect from todays full release update:[/b]
[list][*] 3 New Gigas (Gold King, Blight Queen, and Ezer)
[*] 2 New Stages
[*] Dozens of new Pets
[*] 9 different endings (One end per Giga)
[*] Put a limit to how much Mutation points can be gained from each stage on Endless Mode
[*] Strengthen some Giga skill damage
[*] Various bug fixes and optimizations[/list]
I hope you'll like it, and of course don't hesitate to let me know your honest feedback in [url=https://discord.com/invite/fXqHbQQvnc]Discord[/url] or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1543240]Steam Community Hub[/url]. I am really looking forward to it!

And I would definitely like to [b]THANK YOU[/b] for accompanying me until the full release of [b]Gigapocalypse[/b]! It was an exciting and educational journey and it was just so much fun! Thank you for giving me so much feedback and making [b]Gigapocalypse[/b] what it is today! ❤️

Stay safe, enjoy the update and see you on top of the leaderboards!
Goody

notes.title: 🎃 Trick or treat: Welcome to the Gigapocalypse Halloween Update! 🎃
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40105546/23fa0a115dde6302e65c64fc080c4e9eb1a49de9.png[/img]

Spooky greetings, Kaijū lovers!

It's that time of the year again - it's trick or treat time! Jack-o’-lantern is grinning everywhere, scary and beautiful costumes lurking around every corner and there is the annually Steam Halloween Sale of course!

And that's why [b]Gigapocalypse[/b] is currently not only available with a [b]33% discount[/b], there is also spooky new content in the game: [b]PumpKing Manor[/b]! Collect the Pumpkin Key by destroying buildings and use it to challenge PumpKing Manor on Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty. If you are able to destroy the Pumpkin pinata before the timer ends, a pet is guaranteed as a reward. And the higher the difficuly is, the higher is the level of the pet you will be granted.

[b]There are also some improvements and fixes coming with this update:[/b]

[list][*] Beastiary feature to view all the collected pets added
[*] Pets have a chance to randomly level up when getting them. The higher the stage, the bigger is the chance for a leveled-up pet
[*] Credits screen added
[*] Moved the "Customize" button from the Giga selection menu to upgrade menu
[*] Added a distance progress interface in the bottom interface
[*] Various interface updates
[*] Various bug fixes[/list]
Have a spooky Halloween everyone!

Greetings Kaijū lovers,

I just released the second roadmap update for [b]Gigapocalypse[/b]! ːsteamhappyː Thank you all so much for the awesome feedback and your positive reviews – it's really great to see that you people enjoy playing my game.

So here's the list of new content, fixes and changes that come with the second Early Access update. notes.title: Turn cities to rubble: Gigapocalypse releases into Early Access on July 22nd!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40105546/11cfab1cc1f9ba8b10147f581a95b2037985d023.jpg[/img]

Hey friends,

short and sweet: We finally have an Early Access release date for [b]Gigapocalypse[/b]! You all can start leaving a pixelated trail of destruction [b]on July 22nd[/b]!

In [b]Gigapocalypse[/b] you will control giant Kaijū-inspired monsters – the so-called "Gigas". Evolve your Giga, unlock powerful mutations, skills, and skins, and the ability to spawn up to five cute yet evil minions which accompany your Giga.

Take care of the Gigas with Tamagotchi-style mini-games and decorate their "home" to unlock more upgrades and make them even more menacing. Until the release you can try out [b]Gigapocalypse[/b] here on Steam with a demo.

See you all annihilating the suburbia!
